blocks.text: Ko'p sifatlar juft bo'lib keladi: bor**ing** / bor**ed**, interest**ing** / interest**ed**, tir**ing** / tir**ed**. Ularning ikkalasi ham bitta fe'ldan (bore, interest, tire) yasalgan, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. **-ing** — his-tuyg'uga **sabab bo'ladigan** narsa yoki odam: The film was **boring** — film zeriktirdi. **-ed** — odam **nimani his qilyapti**: I was **bored** — men zerikdim. O'zbek tilida ham shunday farq bor: «**zerikarli**» va «**zerikkan**», «**qiziqarli**» va «**qiziqqan**», «**charchatadigan**» va «**charchagan**». Faqat inglizchada ikki so'z bir-biriga juda o'xshash — shuning uchun adashtirish oson.

rows: hafsalani pir qiladigan / hafsalasi pir bo'lgan
g'ashga tegadigan, tinchlantiruvchi / jahli chiqqan, xotirjam

blocks.text: **-ing** sifati narsa, vaziyat yoki odamning **boshqalarga ta'sirini** tasvirlaydi: a **tiring** journey (odamni charchatadigan yo'l), **shocking** news (larzaga soladigan xabar). U ko'pincha narsa va vaziyatlar haqida ishlatiladi, lekin odam haqida ham bo'lishi mumkin — va bunda ma'no keskin o'zgaradi: Tom is **boring** — Tom **zerikarli odam** (u bilan zerikasiz). Tom is **bored** — Tom **zerikyapti**. Birinchisi — haqorat, ikkinchisi — oddiy holat.

items.text: The second half of the match was much more **exciting**.
Filling in tax forms is the most **boring** job in the world.
items.translation: Soliq blankalarini to'ldirish — dunyodagi eng **zerikarli** ish.

items.text: Our new colleague is really **interesting** — he's lived in five countries.
items.translation: Yangi hamkasbimiz juda **qiziq** odam — u beshta mamlakatda yashagan.

blocks.text: **-ed** sifati faqat his qila oladigan mavjudot — odam (ba'zan hayvon) haqida ishlatiladi. Narsa his qilmaydi, shuning uchun «The film was **bored**» — mumkin emas. Ko'pchilik **-ed** sifatlaridan keyin ma'lum predlog keladi: interested **in**, bored **with / of**, excited **about**, worried **about**, surprised **at / by**, disappointed **with**, frightened **of**, embarrassed **about**, tired **of** («... dan bezor bo'lgan»). Bu birikmalarning eng oddiylari qizil kitobda bor (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars), batafsil → 130–131-darslar.

items.text: Nilufar is very **excited about** her first trip abroad.
items.translation: Nilufar chet elga ilk safari haqida o'ylab juda **hayajonda**.

items.text: I'm **tired of** hearing the same excuses every week.
items.translation: Har hafta bir xil bahonalarni eshitishdan **bezor bo'ldim**.

blocks.text: Ko'pincha bitta vaziyatni ikki tomondan tasvirlash mumkin: sababni (**-ing**) yoki natijani — odamning holatini (**-ed**). Jadvaldagi juftliklar buni yaqqol ko'rsatadi.

Biror narsa **sizga qanday tuyulishini** aytish uchun **find** juda qulay: I **find** this job **stressful** — Bu ish menga **og'ir** tuyuladi. Do you **find** English grammar **confusing**? Bu yerda ham sifat **-ing** shaklida bo'ladi, chunki u narsaning ta'sirini tasvirlaydi. Shuningdek **It's + -ing + to ...** qolipi: It's **embarrassing** to forget someone's name.

items.text: It's **surprising** to see so many cyclists in Tashkent now.
items.translation: Hozir Toshkentda shuncha ko'p velosipedchini ko'rish **ajablanarli**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Men zerikdim» ni «**I'm boring**» deb aytish — bu «Men zerikarli odamman» degani! To'g'risi: I'm **bored**. Xuddi shunday: «I'm interesting in history» → I'm **interested in** history; «The film was very bored» → **boring**; «I'm so exciting about the trip» → **excited**; «I'm confusing» → **confused**; «I'm tiring» → **tired**. Va aksincha: «It was a tired day» → a **tiring** day.

Eslab qolish usuli: **-ed** — men **ichimda** his qilaman (I feel bored). **-ing** — u menga **tashqaridan** ta'sir qiladi (it makes me bored). Shubha bo'lsa, «it makes me ...» bilan tekshiring: The film **makes me bored** → the film is **boring**.

rows: interested in, worried about, tired of ...

examples.title: **bored** and **boring**
examples.description: bored — odam zerikyapti, boring — narsa yoki odam zeriktiradi. «I'm boring» = «men zerikarli odamman».

sentences.text: The lecture was so **boring** that half the students fell asleep.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza shunchalik **zerikarli** ediki, talabalarning yarmi uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: I'm **bored** — there's nothing to do in this village at weekends.
sentences.translation: **Zerikdim** — dam olish kunlari bu qishloqda qiladigan hech narsa yo'q.

sentences.text: Jasur gets **bored** easily, so he changes jobs almost every year.
sentences.translation: Jasur tez **zerikib qoladi**, shuning uchun deyarli har yili ish almashtiradi.

sentences.text: Waiting at the airport for six hours was incredibly **boring**.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda olti soat kutish nihoyatda **zerikarli** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Are you **bored** with your job, or just tired?
sentences.translation: Ishingizdan **zerikdingizmi** yoki shunchaki charchadingizmi?

sentences.text: Her husband is nice, but to be honest, he's a bit **boring**.
sentences.translation: Eri yaxshi odam, lekin rostini aytsam, biroz **zerikarli**.

sentences.text: After an hour in the museum the kids were **bored**, so we went to the park.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda bir soatdan keyin bolalar **zerikib qolishdi**, shuning uchun bog'ga bordik.

sentences.text: Is golf really as **boring** as it looks on TV?
sentences.translation: Golf rostdan ham televizorda ko'ringanidek **zerikarlimi**?

sentences.text: Nothing is more **boring** than a meeting without a clear plan.
sentences.translation: Aniq rejasiz yig'ilishdan ko'ra **zerikarliroq** narsa yo'q.

sentences.text: Bekzod was so **bored** during the flight that he watched four films.
sentences.translation: Bekzod parvoz paytida shunchalik **zerikdiki**, to'rtta film ko'rdi.

examples.title: **interested** and **interesting**
examples.description: interested (in) — odam qiziqadi, interesting — narsa yoki odam qiziqarli. interested dan keyin doim in.

sentences.text: Aziz has always been **interested** in astronomy.
sentences.translation: Aziz doim astronomiyaga **qiziqqan**.

sentences.text: That's an **interesting** idea — let's discuss it at the next meeting.
sentences.translation: Bu **qiziq** fikr — keyingi yig'ilishda muhokama qilaylik.

sentences.text: Are you **interested** in joining our book club? We meet every Thursday.
sentences.translation: Kitobxonlar klubimizga qo'shilishga **qiziqasizmi**? Har payshanba yig'ilamiz.

sentences.text: The most **interesting** part of the tour was the old bazaar.
sentences.translation: Sayohatning eng **qiziqarli** qismi eski bozor bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Sarah isn't **interested** in politics at all.
sentences.translation: Sara siyosatga umuman **qiziqmaydi**.

sentences.text: On the train to Edinburgh I met a really **interesting** woman.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga ketayotgan poyezdda juda **qiziq** ayol bilan tanishdim.

sentences.text: Several companies are **interested** in buying our software.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta kompaniya dasturimizni sotib olishga **qiziqyapti**.

sentences.text: It's **interesting** that most of the top students come from small towns.
sentences.translation: **Qizig'i shundaki**, eng yaxshi talabalarning ko'pi kichik shaharlardan.

sentences.text: If you're **interested**, I can send you the details by email.
sentences.translation: Agar **qiziqsangiz**, tafsilotlarni elektron pochta orqali yuborishim mumkin.

sentences.text: His first book was **interesting**, but the second was a real disappointment.
sentences.translation: Uning birinchi kitobi **qiziqarli** edi, ikkinchisi esa rosa hafsalani pir qildi.

examples.title: **tired** / **tiring**, **exhausted** / **exhausting**
examples.description: tired, exhausted — odam charchagan; tiring, exhausting — ish yoki yo'l charchatadi. tired of — «... dan bezor bo'lgan».

sentences.text: Working night shifts is very **tiring**, especially in winter.
sentences.translation: Tungi smenada ishlash, ayniqsa qishda, juda **charchatadi**.

sentences.text: You look **tired** — did you sleep badly?
sentences.translation: **Charchagan** ko'rinasan — yomon uxladingmi?

sentences.text: The drive from Tashkent to Khiva was long and **tiring**.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Xivagacha mashinada yo'l uzoq va **charchatadigan** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: After the marathon, Emma was completely **exhausted**.
sentences.translation: Marafondan keyin Emma butunlay **holdan toydi**.

sentences.text: Looking after three small children all day is **exhausting**.
sentences.translation: Kun bo'yi uchta kichkina bolaga qarash **odamni holdan toydiradi**.

sentences.text: I'm **tired** of eating the same thing every day.
sentences.translation: Har kuni bir xil narsa yeyishdan **bezor bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: Moving house is one of the most **tiring** things you can do.
sentences.translation: Ko'chib o'tish — eng **charchatadigan** ishlardan biri.

sentences.text: Why are you so **tired**? You only got up an hour ago!
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik **charchagansan**? Bir soat oldin turding-ku!

sentences.text: Long meetings are **exhausting**, so I always take a short walk afterwards.
sentences.translation: Uzoq yig'ilishlar **holdan toydiradi**, shuning uchun keyin doim qisqa sayr qilaman.

sentences.text: The doctors, **exhausted** after a twenty-hour shift, finally went home.
sentences.translation: Yigirma soatlik smenadan keyin **holdan toygan** shifokorlar nihoyat uylariga ketishdi.

examples.title: **surprised**, **shocked**, **amazed** and their -ing forms
examples.description: Kutilmagan narsaga munosabat: surprising / surprised, shocking / shocked, amazing / amazed.

sentences.text: I was **surprised** to see Kate at the party — I thought she was in London.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatda Keytni ko'rib **hayron qoldim** — Londonda deb o'ylagandim.

sentences.text: It's **surprising** how many people still don't use online banking.
sentences.translation: Hali ham qancha odam onlayn bankdan foydalanmasligi **ajablanarli**.

sentences.text: The pictures from the earthquake zone were truly **shocking**.
sentences.translation: Zilzila hududidan kelgan suratlar chindan ham **dahshatli** edi.

sentences.text: Everyone was **shocked** when the director suddenly resigned.
sentences.translation: Direktor to'satdan iste'foga chiqqanda hamma **esankirab qoldi**.

sentences.text: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely **amazing**.
sentences.translation: Tog' cho'qqisidan ochilgan manzara mutlaqo **ajoyib** edi.

sentences.text: Tourists are always **amazed** by the blue tiles of Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar Samarqandning moviy koshinlaridan doim **hayratga tushadi**.

sentences.text: Were you **surprised** by the results of the election?
sentences.translation: Saylov natijalaridan **hayron bo'ldingizmi**?

sentences.text: What's **shocking** is that nobody called an ambulance.
sentences.translation: Eng **dahshatlisi** — hech kim tez yordam chaqirmagan.

sentences.text: Oliver was **amazed** at how quickly his daughter learned to read.
sentences.translation: Oliver qizi o'qishni qanchalik tez o'rganganidan **hayratda qoldi**.

sentences.text: Some of the prices in central London are genuinely **shocking**.
sentences.translation: London markazidagi ba'zi narxlar chindan ham **aqlni shoshiradi**.

examples.title: **worried**, **confused**, **frightened** and their -ing forms
examples.description: Xavotir, chalkashlik va qo'rquv: worrying / worried, confusing / confused, frightening / frightened.

sentences.text: My mum is **worried** because my brother hasn't called for a week.
sentences.translation: Onam **xavotirda**, chunki akam bir haftadan beri qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.

sentences.text: The latest figures on air pollution are very **worrying**.
sentences.translation: Havo ifloslanishi bo'yicha so'nggi raqamlar juda **tashvishli**.

sentences.text: These instructions for the printer are really **confusing**.
sentences.translation: Printerning bu yo'riqnomasi juda **chalkash**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I'm a bit **confused** — is the meeting today or tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **boshim qotib qoldi** — yig'ilish bugunmi yoki ertagami?

sentences.text: Little Madina was **frightened** by the thunder and couldn't sleep.
sentences.translation: Kichkina Madina momaqaldiroqdan **qo'rqib ketdi** va uxlay olmadi.

sentences.text: Driving on mountain roads at night can be really **frightening**.
sentences.translation: Kechasi tog' yo'llarida mashina haydash juda **qo'rqinchli** bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Don't look so **worried** — the exam isn't until next month.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik **xavotirlanma** — imtihon faqat kelasi oyda.

sentences.text: The new tax rules are so **confusing** that even accountants disagree about them.
sentences.translation: Yangi soliq qoidalari shunchalik **chalkashki**, hatto buxgalterlar ham bir fikrga kela olmayapti.

sentences.text: Many people are **frightened** of flying, although it's very safe.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odam samolyotda uchishdan **qo'rqadi**, holbuki bu juda xavfsiz.

sentences.text: It's **worrying** that so many young people can't afford a flat.
sentences.translation: Shuncha ko'p yoshlarning kvartiraga qurbi yetmasligi **tashvishli**.

examples.title: **embarrassed**, **disappointed**, **annoyed** and their -ing forms
examples.description: Xijolat, hafsala pir bo'lishi va jahl: embarrassing / embarrassed, disappointing / disappointed, annoying / annoyed.

sentences.text: I was so **embarrassed** when I called my new boss by the wrong name.
sentences.translation: Yangi boshlig'imni boshqa ism bilan chaqirib yuborib, juda **xijolat bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: Falling over in the middle of the street was really **embarrassing**.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaning o'rtasida yiqilib tushish juda **uyatli** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Our holiday was **disappointing** because it rained every single day.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilimiz **hafsalamizni pir qildi**, chunki har kuni yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: The team's fans were **disappointed** with the result.
sentences.translation: Jamoa muxlislarining natijadan **hafsalasi pir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: It's really **annoying** when people talk loudly on their phones on the bus.
sentences.translation: Avtobusda odamlar telefonda baland gaplashsa, juda **g'ashga tegadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was **annoyed** because nobody had told her about the change of plan.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **jahli chiqdi**, chunki reja o'zgargani haqida unga hech kim aytmagan edi.

sentences.text: Are you **disappointed** that you didn't get the job?
sentences.translation: Ishga olinmaganingizdan **hafsalangiz pir bo'ldimi**?

sentences.text: My most **embarrassing** moment was singing the wrong song at a wedding.
sentences.translation: Mening eng **uyatli** lahzam — to'yda boshqa qo'shiqni aytib yuborganim.

sentences.text: Considering the price, the service at the hotel was **disappointing**.
sentences.translation: Narxini hisobga olsak, mehmonxonadagi xizmat **ko'ngilni qoldirdi**.

sentences.text: Tom gets **annoyed** if anyone touches his computer.
sentences.translation: Kimdir kompyuteriga tegsa, Tomning **jahli chiqadi**.

examples.title: **find** it **confusing**; **amused**, **relaxed**, **fascinated**
examples.description: find + ot + -ing sifat — «menga ... tuyuladi». Yana bir nechta juftlik: amusing / amused, relaxing / relaxed, fascinating / fascinated.

sentences.text: My grandmother **finds** online banking a bit **confusing**, so I help her.
sentences.translation: Onlayn bank buvimga biroz **chalkash tuyuladi**, shuning uchun unga yordam beraman.

sentences.text: Do you **find** your new job **satisfying**?
sentences.translation: Yangi ishingiz sizga **qoniqish beryaptimi**?

sentences.text: Many people **find** gardening very **relaxing** after a stressful day.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odamga og'ir kundan keyin bog'da ishlash **asabni tinchlantiradi**.

sentences.text: Madina **finds** speaking in public absolutely **terrifying**.
sentences.translation: Madina uchun omma oldida gapirish mutlaqo **dahshatli**.

sentences.text: After a week by the sea, I came home feeling completely **relaxed**.
sentences.translation: Dengiz bo'yida bir hafta dam olib, uyga butunlay **xotirjam** qaytdim.

sentences.text: Sarah was **amused** by the story, but I didn't find it **amusing** at all.
sentences.translation: Hikoya Sarani **kuldirdi**, lekin menga u umuman **kulgili** tuyulmadi.

sentences.text: The students looked **confused**, so the teacher explained the rule again.
sentences.translation: Talabalarning **boshi qotgani** ko'rinib turardi, shuning uchun o'qituvchi qoidani qayta tushuntirdi.

sentences.text: Why do you always **find** my friends **boring**?
sentences.translation: Nega do'stlarim senga doim **zerikarli** tuyuladi?

sentences.text: Learning a new language is **challenging**, but it's never **boring**.
sentences.translation: Yangi til o'rganish **mashaqqatli**, lekin hech qachon **zerikarli** emas.

sentences.text: We were **fascinated** by the old manuscripts in the library.
sentences.translation: Kutubxonadagi qadimiy qo'lyozmalar bizni **maftun etdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a **disappointing** holiday
examples.description: Ikki dugona ta'til haqida gaplashadi: -ing va -ed sifatlari jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hi Emma! How was your holiday in Spain? Was it **relaxing**?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Emma! Ispaniyadagi ta'tiling qanday o'tdi? **Yaxshi dam oldingmi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. To be honest, it was a bit **disappointing**.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Rostini aytsam, biroz **hafsalam pir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! Were you **disappointed** with the hotel?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Mehmonxonadan **ko'ngling qoldimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, the photos online looked **amazing**, but the room was tiny.
sentences.translation: — Ha, internetdagi suratlar **ajoyib** ko'ringan edi, lekin xona juda kichkina ekan.

sentences.text: — That's so **annoying**! Did you complain to the manager?
sentences.translation: — Bu juda **alam qiladi**! Menejerga shikoyat qildingmi?

sentences.text: — I did, but he just looked **confused** and said he couldn't help.
sentences.translation: — Qildim, lekin u **dovdirab qoldi** va yordam berolmasligini aytdi.

sentences.text: — How **frustrating**! And what about the beach? Was that nice?
sentences.translation: — Qanday **asabbuzar**! Plyaj-chi? U yaxshimidi?

sentences.text: — The beach was lovely, but the kids got **bored** after a day.
sentences.translation: — Plyaj ajoyib edi, lekin bolalar bir kundan keyin **zerikib qolishdi**.

sentences.text: — Kids always get **bored** on beach holidays — mine are exactly the same!
sentences.translation: — Bolalar dengiz bo'yidagi ta'tilda doim **zerikishadi** — meniklar ham xuddi shunday!

sentences.text: — Next year I'm booking somewhere more **exciting**, like Istanbul.
sentences.translation: — Kelasi yil **qiziqarliroq** joyni band qilaman, masalan, Istanbulni.
